title: Registered test commands

request.details: Read the original registered commands below. If empty, use repository scripts, configuration and existing results as evidence. See submit/self_check and the relevant test instruction for execution.

response.engine_recipe_details: Before writing TS preparation steps, fetch the engine recipes. Pick the engine that matches the code under test (for example, engine=pytest) and copy its setup as-is. If there is no recipe for the engine, write the setup. A successful run registers it automatically.

errors: Report test_command_missing if no command can be determined.
